question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Startle
solution: The correct answer is **'Surprise'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Startle**__**: To surprise somebody in a way that slightly shocks or frightens him (किसी को थोड़ा परेशान करते या डराते हुए आश्‍चर्य में डाल देना****)** __ • **E.g.__​**- The gunshot **startled** the horses. • __**Surprise**__**: To make somebody feel surprised (किसी को आश्‍चर्यचकित करना****)** __ • **E.g.__​**- It wouldn’t **surprise** me if you get the job. Hence, the correct answer is **'Surprise'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** __ • **Scare**__**: To make a person or an animal frightened (व्यक्ति या वस्‍तु को डरा देना, भयभीत कर देना****)** __ • **E.g.__​**- The sudden noise **scared** us all. • __**Humiliate**__**: To make somebody feel very embarrassed (किसी को नीचा दिखाना****)** __ • **E.g.__​**- I felt **humiliated** when the teacher laughed at my work. • __**Shame**__**: A fact or situation that makes you feel disappointed (लज्‍जाजनक वास्‍तविकता या स्थिति****)** __ • **E.g.__​**- It’s a **shame** about Anand failing his exams. 3a:T40a, The correct answer is** 'Lose the job'.**
